name: investment-analyst
description: Sweden-first equity research on free, keyless primary sources - no API keys, no paid feeds, no identifying requests. Enforces provenance, temporal validity, source independence and the decision's own arithmetic in code rather than instructions. Sizes the position too: scenario distribution to fractional Kelly, uncertainty adjustment, conviction ceiling, bear-case risk budget, liquidity and portfolio caps, graded concentration - a missing input returns insufficient_data, and NO_BET is the judgement that the edge does not justify a position. Scores its own scenario probabilities with proper scoring rules and offers no calibration adjustment below its sample floor. Plain-language answers; full evidence and valuation build on request. TTM engine, valuation gate, validated decision record with enforced conviction caps, falsifiable thesis ledger, portfolio review, 1326-test regression suite covering the instruction layer and the sizing invariants as well as the code. Screens Nasdaq Stockholm, Copenhagen and Helsinki plus Oslo Bors; Sweden remains the default.
